events.text: Cardinal Angelo Maria Durini purchased the property.

evidence.quote: Cardinal Angelo Maria Durini purchased this property in 1785

events.text: Durini converted the monastery into a summer villa and added a loggia.

evidence.quote: In 1787 , he converted the monastery structure into a villa for use during the summer

events.text: Villa passed to the cardinal's nephew, Luigi Porro Lambertenghi.

evidence.quote: After the cardinal’s death in 1796 , the villa passed to his nephew

events.label: arrest
events.text: Silvio Pellico was arrested at the villa by the Austrian government

evidence.quote: In 1820 , Pellico was arrested at the villa by the Austrian government

events.text: Butler Ames obtained ownership of the villa after repeated cash offers.

evidence.quote: until in 1919 he was successful in obtaining ownership

events.text: Ames's heirs sold the villa to Count Guido Monzino.

evidence.quote: In 1974 , Amess heirs sold the villa to businessman and explorer Count Guido Monzino

events.text: Monzino died and left the villa to the Fondo Ambiente Italiano (FAI).

evidence.quote: Monzino died in 1988 and left the villa along with most of the Dosso dAvedo

events.text: FAI commenced a €413,000 project to restore the villa's jetty and systems.

evidence.quote: In 2016 the Fondo per lAmbiente Italiano commenced a €413,000 project to restore and improve the villa’s jetty

events.label: wedding
events.text: Wedding of Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukone took place at the villa

evidence.quote: In November 2018 Indian movie star and Bollywoods famous couple Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukones wedding took place at the villa
